RUN mv /root/.local/share/lazybox/libexec/static-curl /root/.local/share/lazybox/libexec/static-curl.bin
COPY --chmod=0755 <<'STATIC_CURL' /root/.local/share/lazybox/libexec/static-curl
#!/bin/sh
OPENSSL_CONF="${OPENSSL_CONF:-/dev/null}" exec "$(dirname "$0")/static-curl.bin" "$@"
STATIC_CURL

RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/zypper-store,id=/zypper-store,sharing=shared --mount=type=cache,target=/var/cache/zypp,id=yogurt-release-docker:/var/cache/zypp,sharing=locked s=/zypper-store; d=/var/cache/zypp/packages; mkdir -p "$s" "$d"; cp -r "$s"/. "$d"/ 2>/dev/null || true; zypper -n modifyservice --no-refresh --all && sed -i 's|http://|https://|g' /etc/zypp/repos.d/*.repo || exit; zypper -n modifyrepo --keep-packages --all && zypper -n install findutils=4.10.0-160000.2.2 which=2.23-160000.2.2 git-core=2.51.0-160000.1.2 libatomic1=15.3.0+git11272-160000.1.1 || exit; cd "$d" && for f in */*.rpm */*/*.rpm; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; o="$s/$f"; [ -e "$o" ] && continue; mkdir -p "$(dirname "$o")"; t="$(mktemp "$(dirname "$o")/.pXXXXXX")" && cp "$f" "$t" && mv -f "$t" "$o"; done; zypper -n modifyrepo --no-keep-packages --all || true

RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/zypper-store,id=/zypper-store,sharing=shared --mount=type=cache,target=/var/cache/zypp,id=yogurt-release-docker:/var/cache/zypp,sharing=locked p="$PWD"; s=/zypper-store; d=/var/cache/zypp/packages; mkdir -p "$s" "$d"; cp -r "$s"/. "$d"/ 2>/dev/null || true; zypper -n modifyservice --no-refresh --all && sed -i 's|http://|https://|g' /etc/zypp/repos.d/*.repo || exit; zypper -n modifyrepo --keep-packages --all && zypper -n install postgresql18-server=18.6-160000.1.1 postgresql18-contrib=18.6-160000.1.1 libopenssl3=3.5.0-160000.10.1 || exit; cd "$d" && for f in */*.rpm */*/*.rpm; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; o="$s/$f"; [ -e "$o" ] && continue; mkdir -p "$(dirname "$o")"; t="$(mktemp "$(dirname "$o")/.pXXXXXX")" && cp "$f" "$t" && mv -f "$t" "$o"; done; zypper -n modifyrepo --no-keep-packages --all || true; (cd "$p" && rm -rf /usr/lib/locale/* && mkdir -p /run/postgresql && chown -R postgres:postgres /run/postgresql) || exit
epilogue: RUN printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/sh' 'set -e' 'if [ "$1" = "postgres" ]; then shift; fi' 'export PGDATA="${PGDATA:-/var/lib/pgsql/data}"' 'export POSTGRES_DB="${POSTGRES_DB:-yogurt}"' 'export PATH="/usr/lib/postgresql18/bin:$PATH"' 'q=$(printf "\047")' 'if [ ! -s "$PGDATA/PG_VERSION" ]; then' '  mkdir -p "$PGDATA" /run/postgresql' '  chown -R postgres:postgres "$PGDATA" /run/postgresql' '  setpriv --reuid=postgres --regid=postgres --clear-groups initdb -D "$PGDATA" --no-sync --encoding=UTF8 --auth=trust --locale-provider=icu --icu-locale=und --locale=C' '  setpriv --reuid=postgres --regid=postgres --clear-groups pg_ctl -D "$PGDATA" -w -o "-c listen_addresses='\'''\'' $*" start' '  if [ "$POSTGRES_DB" != "postgres" ]; then setpriv --reuid=postgres --regid=postgres --clear-groups psql -U postgres -d postgres -c "CREATE DATABASE \"$POSTGRES_DB\""; fi' '  setpriv --reuid=postgres --regid=postgres --clear-groups psql -U postgres -d "$POSTGRES_DB" -c "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS _pronto_migrations (name text primary key, applied_at timestamptz default now())"' '  for f in /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/*.sql; do' '    if [ -f "$f" ]; then' '      echo "Applying $f..."' '      setpriv --reuid=postgres --regid=postgres --clear-groups psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d "$POSTGRES_DB" -f "$f"' '      base=$(basename "$f")' '      setpriv --reuid=postgres --regid=postgres --clear-groups psql -U postgres -d "$POSTGRES_DB" -c "INSERT INTO _pronto_migrations (name) VALUES ($q$base$q) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING"' '    fi' '  done' '  setpriv --reuid=postgres --regid=postgres --clear-groups pg_ctl -D "$PGDATA" -m fast -w stop' 'else' '  setpriv --reuid=postgres --regid=postgres --clear-groups pg_ctl -D "$PGDATA" -w -o "-c listen_addresses='\'''\'' $*" start' '  setpriv --reuid=postgres --regid=postgres --clear-groups psql -U postgres -d "$POSTGRES_DB" -c "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS _pronto_migrations (name text primary key, applied_at timestamptz default now())"' '  for f in /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/*.sql; do' '    if [ -f "$f" ]; then' '      base=$(basename "$f")' '      case "$base" in *seed*) continue;; esac' '      applied=$(setpriv --reuid=postgres --regid=postgres --clear-groups psql -t -A -U postgres -d "$POSTGRES_DB" -c "SELECT count(*) FROM _pronto_migrations WHERE name = $q$base$q")' '      if [ "$applied" = "0" ]; then' '        echo "Applying pending migration $f..."' '        setpriv --reuid=postgres --regid=postgres --clear-groups psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d "$POSTGRES_DB" -f "$f"' '        setpriv --reuid=postgres --regid=postgres --clear-groups psql -U postgres -d "$POSTGRES_DB" -c "INSERT INTO _pronto_migrations (name) VALUES ($q$base$q)"' '      fi' '    fi' '  done' '  setpriv --reuid=postgres --regid=postgres --clear-groups pg_ctl -D "$PGDATA" -m fast -w stop' 'fi' 'exec setpriv --reuid=postgres --regid=postgres --clear-groups postgres -D "$PGDATA" -c listen_addresses=127.0.0.1 "$@"' > /usr/local/bin/docker-entrypoint.sh && chmod 755 /usr/local/bin/docker-entrypoint.sh
RUN printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/sh' 'if [ "$1" = "microcheck" ]; then' '  shift' '  exec "$@"' 'fi' 'exec "$@"' > /usr/local/bin/bayt && chmod 755 /usr/local/bin/bayt
RUN printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/sh' 'while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do if [ "$1" = "--" ]; then shift; break; fi; shift; done' 'exec "$@"' > /usr/local/bin/mise && chmod 755 /usr/local/bin/mise

RUN printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/sh' 'set -e' 'for n in crud database auth; do' '  grep -Eq "^[^#]*[[:space:]]$n([[:space:]]|$)" /etc/hosts || echo "127.0.0.1 $n" >> /etc/hosts || { echo "appliance: cannot name $n in /etc/hosts" >&2; exit 1; }' 'done' 'export PORT="${PORT:-8080}"' 'export CADDY_HTTP_PORT="${PORT}"' 'export CADDY_TLS_HOST_PORT="${PORT}"' 'if [ -n "$ORIGIN" ]; then' '  if [ -z "$WEBAUTHN_RP_ID" ]; then' '    h="${ORIGIN#*://}"' '    h="${h%%/*}"' '    h="${h%%:*}"' '    if [ -n "$h" ] && [ "$h" != "localhost" ]; then export WEBAUTHN_RP_ID="$h"; fi' '  fi' '  if [ -z "$WEBAUTHN_ORIGIN" ] && [ -n "$WEBAUTHN_RP_ID" ] && [ "$WEBAUTHN_RP_ID" != "localhost" ]; then export WEBAUTHN_ORIGIN="$ORIGIN"; fi' 'fi' 'exec "$@"' > /usr/local/bin/appliance-entrypoint.sh && chmod 755 /usr/local/bin/appliance-entrypoint.sh

RUN awk 'skip { d += gsub(/\{/, "{") - gsub(/\}/, "}"); if (d <= 0) skip = 0; next } /handle @rendered \{/ { skip = 1; d = 1; next } { print }' /etc/caddy/Caddyfile > /tmp/Caddyfile && mv /tmp/Caddyfile /etc/caddy/Caddyfile
